faults.why: Sino-Vietnamese bound root (昏), not a standalone verb/adjective in Vietnamese.

faults.quote: Trời tối hôn, không nhìn rõ đường.
faults.why: 'Tối hôn' is not a valid Vietnamese phrase (confused with 'hoàng hôn' or 'tối om').

faults.quote: to kiss; to be dark or murky
faults.why: Includes the invalid 'dark or murky' sense.

faults.quote: in certain regional or old-fashioned contexts, it can also relate to darkness
faults.why: False claim; it is a Sino-Vietnamese morpheme in compounds like 'hoàng hôn', not standalone.
